DJFilter.notes: The tooltip and the manual both give the lowpass half of the sweep as 20Hz to 2000Hz. The display code does use 2000Hz (DJFilter.cpp:19) but the audio path rescales the same half onto 20Hz to 7000Hz (DJFilter.cpp:133), so the figure shown is wrong everywhere except at the bottom of the sweep. Spatializer.notes: delaySamples is computed inside the branch that runs only when the time control or the range switch changes, and it is computed from slewedTime, which is updated afterwards (Spatializer.cpp:90-100 and :111). SeventiesEQ.notes: The three frequency selectors each carry an Off position that the manual omits, and Off is the default, so a new module has only the input gain, the 10kHz shelf and the output level doing anything (SeventiesEQ.cpp:219-228).
